depiction.primary_object: wireframe globe with latitude and longitude lines
depiction.composition: single object with upper-right overlay badge

readings.meaning: web security, HTTPS, or SSL certificate
private network, intranet, or restricted website access
parental controls or internet access lock

ambiguity: May be confused with a generic padlock (passwords) or plain globe (websites) at very small sizes, or with Wi-Fi security.

modifier_semantics.meaning: secured, encrypted, private, or restricted access

task_intents: renew website SSL or TLS certificate
set up or configure VPN client
configure firewall or network access rules
set up parental controls for internet
audit website privacy and security headers

reasoning: A wireframe globe combined with a closed padlock clearly represents web security, HTTPS/SSL certificates, VPNs, or restricted internet access. It is an unmistakable fit for sysadmin, web development, and personal online privacy tasks, though somewhat narrower in everyday life than a plain globe or plain lock.
